card.summary: S. 4784, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027, establishes policies, organizational structures, funding limits, and authorities for Department of Defense and Department of Energy national security programs. It covers military organization, vessel acquisition, counterterrorism, cyber and artificial intelligence, reporting requirements, and military construction.
